output.summary: A widespread deciduous tree native to eastern and central North America. Its flowers, twigs, leaf stalks and seeds show varying amounts of red, while its autumn leaves can become brilliant deep scarlet. Its sap makes maple syrup, but it must be tapped before the buds emerge, giving a short season.
output.edibilityNote: Sap is made into maple syrup but must be tapped before the early-emerging buds open.
